<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <text x="18" y="24" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>

    <rect x="332" y="71" width="34" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Hero artwork block -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="112" width="354" height="332" rx="22" fill="#0C0C0F"/>
    <rect x="22" y="116" width="346" height="324" rx="20" fill="#111217"/>
    <rect x="22" y="116" width="346" height="324" rx="20" fill="#0E121A"/>
    <polygon points="42,180 86,138 128,174 160,148 208,185 248,145 296,178 338,154 338,440 42,440" fill="#1A1F2C"/>

    <circle cx="308" cy="150" r="18" fill="#F4D24E" opacity="0.22"/>
    <rect x="34" y="258" width="322" height="86" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.34"/>
    <text x="40" y="170" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">MLB® The Show™ 22</text>
    <text x="40" y="194" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.92">La edición definitiva para vivir el béisbol con más realismo,</text>
    <text x="40" y="213" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.92">contenido y competencia en PS4™ y PS5™.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="40" y="286" width="120" height="24" rx="12" fill="#0072CE"/>
      <text x="100" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Incluido en PS Plus</text>
      <rect x="168" y="286" width="88" height="24" rx="12" fill="#2A2830"/>
      <text x="212" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Deportes</text>
      <rect x="264" y="286" width="92" height="24" rx="12" fill="#2A2830"/>
      <text x="310" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Solo en español</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="40" y="324" width="128" height="44" rx="14" fill="#FF6B00"/>
      <text x="104" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Comprar</text>
      <rect x="176" y="324" width="108" height="44" rx="14" fill="#2A2830"/>
      <text x="230" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Más detalles</text>
      <rect x="292" y="324" width="64" height="44" rx="14" fill="#1F2230"/>
      <circle cx="324" cy="346" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="330.5" y1="352.5" x2="337" y2="359" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Section: details -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="474" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Descripción</text>
    <text x="327" y="474" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#2C5CF4">Ver todo</text>
    <rect x="20" y="488" width="350" height="118" rx="18" fill="#222228"/>
    <rect x="22" y="490" width="346" height="114" rx="16" fill="#2A2830"/>
    <text x="36" y="514" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Con el nuevo MLB® The Show™, hay más formas que nunca de</text>
    <text x="36" y="533" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">construir tu carrera, competir con amigos y dominar el diamante.</text>
    <text x="36" y="555" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Crea y usa múltiples jugadores de béisbol, mejora tu roster y</text>
    <text x="36" y="574" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">descubre nuevas formas de jugar en línea.</text>
    <g>
      <circle cx="34" cy="592" r="4.5" fill="#0072CE"/>
      <text x="46" y="596" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF">Actualizaciones de temporada y eventos en vivo</text>
      <circle cx="252" cy="592" r="4.5" fill="#0072CE"/>
      <text x="264" y="596" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF">Compatibilidad multiplataforma</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Ratings / metadata cards -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="632" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Valoración</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="644" width="166" height="74" rx="16" fill="#222228"/>
      <text x="34" y="670" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">4.8</text>

      </g>
      <text x="34" y="694" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.82">Más de 23 mil reseñas</text>
      <text x="34" y="714" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.82">Precio base: US$59.99</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="194" y="644" width="176" height="74" rx="16" fill="#222228"/>
      <text x="208" y="670" font-family="Gilroy, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Ediciones</text>
      <rect x="208" y="680" width="68" height="24" rx="12" fill="#0072CE"/>
      <text x="242" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Estándar</text>
      <rect x="284" y="680" width="72" height="24" rx="12" fill="#2A2830"/>
      <text x="320" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Deluxe</text>
      <text x="208" y="716" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.82">Disponible ahora</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Thumbnails row -->

    <polygon points="272,806 296,781 317,795 332,784 358,806" fill="#3B435A"/>

    <g transform="translate(251,786)">

      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Biblioteca</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
